alt: Official Consumer Complaint Form filed with the San Diego County District Attorney's Office Consumer Protection Team against Grow Therapy Inc. and provider Kifle Jikamo PMHNP on June 15, 2026, documenting B&P Code Section 2054 violations and insurance billing irregularities.
summary: This formal Consumer Complaint was executed and filed under penalty of perjury with the San Diego District Attorney's Economic Crimes & Consumer Protection Division on June 15, 2026. It reports Grow Therapy Inc. for hosting misleading medical advertisements and billing L.A. Care / Medi-Cal for non-rendered services. It references NP Kifle Jikamo's deceptive credentialing as 'Dr.' in clinical settings, citing federal precedent Palmer v. Bonta and state Business & Professions Code Section 2054. It requests prosecutorial intervention under False Advertising (BPC Section 17500) and Unfair Competition (BPC Section 17200) laws.
full_text: Consumer Complaint Form. Office of the District Attorney. San Diego County. Today's date: 06/15/2026. Your Information: Nicolas Hernandez. Business/Individual(s) Complaint Filed Against: Grow Therapy Inc. (concerning provider Kifle Jikamo). Phone: (786) 244-7711. Email: support@growtherapy.com. Address: 156 5th Ave, New York, NY 10010. Did you complain to the Business/Individual? Yes. Emailed support@growtherapy.com months ago re: BPC 2054 title violation. No response. Date and Location of Incident: San Diego County. Date of transaction: 02/03/2026. Was this an online transaction? Yes. Link: https://growtherapy.com/provider/0tu8x48m031o/dr-kifle-jikamo. Have you filed a complaint with any other agency? Yes. Registered Nursing, Board of. Case number: 4002026006579. Summary of Incident: I am filing this complaint against Grow Therapy for hosting misleading medical advertising violating BPC 2054(a). On Feb 3, 2026, I booked a telehealth session via Grow Therapy with Kifle Jikamo, who is advertised as 'Dr. Kifle Jikamo.' I was seeking specialized medication-assisted treatment (MAT/Suboxone) for Opioid Use Disorder, believing he was a medical physician. During the encounter, Jikamo did not clarify he is a Nurse Practitioner. He conducted a 5-minute session, refused to provide treatment, and terminated the call without a clinical assessment. Despite refusing care, he billed my Medi-Cal plan (L.A. Care) for a full service, which was paid. Using 'Dr.' in a clinical setting by a non-physician is a misdemeanor under California BPC 2054. Under Palmer v. Bonta (Sept 2025), a federal court held that this use of 'Dr.' is inherently misleading to consumers, regardless of fine-print disclosures. I was personally misled by this advertisement, resulting in delayed medical care and billing fraud. I filed a complaint with the California Board of Registered Nursing (Case #4002026006579) on March 5, 2026. However, because state licensing boards have massive backlogs and the deceptive profile is still actively hosted by Grow Therapy, I request the District Attorney's Consumer Protection Unit intervene under False Advertising (BPC 17500) and Unfair Competition (BPC 17200) laws. Amount of Loss and Type of Payment: $0 personal (Medi-Cal/L.A. Care billed and paid). Upload signed contracts and other supporting documents: growtherapy-email.png, paid-insurance-claim.pdf, jikamo-growtherapy-profile-screenshot.png, jikamo-nursing-board-complaint.pdf. Nicolas Hernandez. Date signed: 06/15/2026.
